name: fill_barb_wall_front
feature: hopper B's front wall above the front barb pocket -- what the fill lid's front snap tab pulls against

name: fill_barb_wall_back
feature: the module's back wall above the rear barb pocket

name: pick_lid_skirt_catch
feature: a bay divider's share of the front face, above the scallop line -- what the pick lid's skirt catches on, and the only thing stopping the lid sliding down its own 38.7 degree plane

name: rail_buttress_right_back
feature: buttress carrying the rear joining groove, which is cut deeper than the side wall is thick

name: cubby_deck
feature: the deck between the accessory cubby and the crossing chute above it -- 3mm at the back face, thickening to 14 at the cubby's front because the cubby ceiling runs at 45 degrees while the chute floor runs at 40 (D21); here, mid-cubby, it is about 8.8

name: fill_catch_front
feature: the catch the fill lid's front barb latches on: the wall between the top of the barb pocket and the bottom of the seat-ledge relief above it. 0.7mm in revision 5; fill_catch_t (2.7) in revision 6, asserted in params.scad

name: vault_deck
feature: the deck between the vault ridge of bay 3's chute ceiling and hopper B's floor above it, mid-leg: chute_ceil (3mm) at the ridge, the thinnest the deck under hopper B gets after the vault (D26)
